title: First public-synthetic measurement over the pii-evidence snapshot public-pii-phi/2026-10-07/9d4e8e036bbb
notAClaim: Not Redact Secret product qualification: no threshold, support state, ranking, release approval or stable/provisional decision.
Not a protected evaluation: no protected corpus, private custodian, private ledger, EC2 or production key was used or is needed.
Not accuracy evidence about real-world values: the corpus is reserved or documented-test values by design, mostly unlabeled, authored by one project without independent review.
A complete measurement is not a verdict: every rate below is a descriptive count under the protocol, with the denominators and withheld states the artifact records.

engine.name: pii-eval

buildSourceTreeDigest.algorithm: sha256 of `git ls-tree -r HEAD -- crates Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml` (survives a squash merge while those paths are unchanged)

engine.binariesNote: Host and toolchain specific (darwin-arm64); recorded for audit, not compared by the reproduction.

scanner.selection: The only real scanner adapter this repository ships: @redact-secret/core 0.1.0-beta.12 through the production shim, run locally from the public npm registry. The repository ships no other real scanner; the inert fake package is a test double and was not used.
scanner.install: npm ci --ignore-scripts from tools/pii-evidence/scanner (committed package.json and package-lock.json)

execution.meaning: A live scanner process was launched by `pii-eval run` (official mode, run class public-synthetic, product released); its normalized observations are the observation set.
execution.command: node tools/pii-evidence/reproduce.mjs (steps verify, import, plan, run)

replay.meaning: `pii-eval replay` re-derived the artifacts from the observation set alone. No scanner was launched. It is a stability check of the engine's scoring, not an additional sample.
replay.command: pii-eval replay --snapshot <imported snapshot.json> --manifest manifest.json --observation observation-redact-secret-core.json --original run-artifact.json --out <dir> --expect-snapshot-digest <populationDigest> --expect-manifest-digest <manifestDigest>
